text: まだ　あまり　なれていない　のね　であった　ときは　だれでも　このくらい　なのよ

structure.jp: まだ　あまり　なれていない　のね
structure.en: it isn't very used to you yet, I see

structure.jp: だれでも　このくらい　なのよ
structure.en: it's about like this for anyone

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus いる says a state is going on now; いない makes it 'not'. まだ　なれていない = 'hasn't gotten used to you yet'.

patterns.name: 〜とき
patterns.explanation: とき after a verb means 'when'; the past form before it means the action is already done at that moment. であった　とき = 'when you have just met'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.span: なれていない　のね
patterns.explanation: の at the end is the soft form of のだ and gives or notices an explanation. なれていない　のね = 'so it isn't used to you, I see'.
